source_OCR_wrong_value: Visible ingredient is one-eighth; source OCR and current raw diff/text layer report one-quarter. Do not edit either original or rewrite numeric output from this known label.

whole_page_position_loss.behavior: OcrPageContent::PositionedText positions are validated and converted, but target.image=None stores only string lines in recognized. Rendering via page_ocr::add_lines discards bounds and uses default body formatting.
whole_page_position_loss.required_invariant: When the caller supplies valid whole-page OCR coordinates, preserve them together with caller line order. Keep existing unpositioned text/blank/resource/output-preservation contracts. Do not sort columns into a different reading order to make geometry easier.

oversized_page.behavior: parsed_page_size_twips emits43527 width, above Word31680. Bundled LibreOffice renders this width but that is not evidence of Word compatibility.
oversized_page.required_invariant: All output page dimensions must meet Word bounds. Preserve content and relative geometry through a documented proportionate fit when possible, with quality/strict behavior explicit. Do not clamp only page size and crop content.

registration: Not yet registered; failures and correlated source family remain explicit.
